title: OpsTruss event
description: One event of a run, as --json prints it and events.jsonl keeps it. Readers ignore fields and types they do not know.

status.description: Of the first event of a run, a unit operation, a task, or a step: running; of the last one, which also has outcome: finished.

outputs.description: Of the last event of a run: the outputs of its task, each with value, sensitive, and type, as the record of the run has them.

plan.description: Of a plan event: the plan of its unit, as units.<n>.plan has it: changes, outputs, exact, digest, summary, and reason, changed, after, and reads when they apply.

sudo.description: Of the debug event that a program with sudo: true starts with, as root through sudo or as an OpsTruss that is root: true.
